nodes.name: user_session_display.py
nodes.summary: Virtual DocType for displaying user session information. All CRUD operations raise NotImplementedError, indicating this is a read-only virtual document that gets its data from elsewhere (likely Redis sessions).

nodes.name: UserSessionDisplay
nodes.summary: Virtual Document class for user session display. Overrides db_insert, load_from_db, db_update, and delete to raise NotImplementedError, making it a non-persistent display-only child table document with fields for IP address, user agent, and session timestamps.

nodes.name: user_social_login.py
nodes.summary: Child table DocType that stores social login provider information (provider, userid, username) for a User document. Used for OAuth/social authentication integrations.

nodes.name: UserSocialLogin
nodes.summary: Simple child table Document class storing social login credentials with fields for provider, userid, and username. No custom logic - relies entirely on base Document class behavior.

nodes.name: test_user_type.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the User Type DocType. Tests that select permissions are correctly added for link fields and child table link fields, and that print/share/email permissions default to enabled for backward compatibility.

nodes.name: TestUserType
nodes.summary: Integration test case for User Type. Tests select permission auto-population from link fields and default permission values (print, share, email) for backward compatibility.

nodes.name: create_user_type
nodes.summary: Test helper that creates a User Type document with a custom role and Contact doctype permissions. Updates site config with the user type limit before creation.

nodes.name: create_role
nodes.summary: Test helper that creates the '_Test User Type' custom role if it doesn't exist.

nodes.name: user_type.js
nodes.summary: Client-side form controller for User Type DocType. Sets up query filters for document type fields (non-table doctypes), role field (custom, enabled, desk roles), and dynamically fetches user ID field options based on the selected apply_user_permission_on doctype.

nodes.name: user_type.py
nodes.summary: Core User Type DocType controller implementing a permission management system for non-standard user types. Handles role-based permission assignment, module access control, document type limits, select permission auto-population, and user permission propagation for restricted user accounts.

nodes.name: UserType
nodes.summary: Document controller for User Type that manages non-standard user types with restricted permissions. Handles validate/on_update/on_trash lifecycle hooks, auto-populates select permissions from link fields, manages role permissions for user/select/file doctypes, validates document type limits from site config, and updates associated user roles and modules.

nodes.name: add_role_permissions
nodes.summary: Helper function that ensures a Custom DocPerm record exists for the given doctype and role at permlevel 0, creating one if needed.

nodes.name: get_non_standard_user_types
nodes.summary: Returns a dictionary of non-standard user types mapping name to [apply_user_permission_on, user_id_field]. Used for caching user type configuration.

nodes.name: get_user_linked_doctypes
nodes.summary: Whitelisted search handler that returns doctypes linked to User via DocField or Custom Field. Excludes frappe module doctypes, single/submittable/read-only types. Used for the apply_user_permission_on field query.

nodes.name: get_user_id
nodes.summary: Whitelisted function that returns all User-type Link fields (both standard and custom) for a given parent doctype. Used to populate the user_id_field dropdown.

nodes.name: user_linked_with_permission_on_doctype
nodes.summary: Validates that a user is linked to a record in the apply_user_permission_on doctype via the user_id_field. Returns True if linked or no permission doctype is set, otherwise shows a message guiding the user to set up the link.

nodes.name: apply_permissions_for_non_standard_user_type
nodes.summary: Doc event handler that creates/updates user permissions for non-standard user types when a document's user field changes. Uses cached non-standard user type config to determine which documents need permission records. Sets up roles, modules, and user permissions for the linked user.

nodes.name: user_type_dashboard.py
nodes.summary: Dashboard configuration for User Type showing linked User documents via the user_type field.

nodes.name: user_type_list.js
nodes.summary: List view settings for User Type showing Standard (green) or Custom (blue) indicators based on the is_standard field.
